metadata.name: 2pl_latent_reg_irt
metadata.title: Two-parameter logistic item theory model with latent regression
metadata.description: The Rasch model (Rasch 1960) is an item response theory model for dichotomous items. The two-parameter logistic model (2PL) (Swaminathan and Gifford 1985) is an item response theory model that includes parameters for both the difficulty and discrimination of dichotomous items. The version presented includes a latent regression. However, the latent regression part of the model may be restricted to an intercept only, resulting in a regular 2PL.

metadata.name: Mh_model
metadata.title: Logistic-Normal Heterogeneity Model
metadata.description:
Heterogeneity is inherent difference
          in the behaviour of individuals. Individual heterogeneity is

          and the model for the noise is the normal distribution.

metadata.name: Mt_model

metadata.name: Mtbh_model
metadata.title: Capture-recapture model where detection probability varies by occasion
metadata.description:
The model Mtbh estimates the size of a closed population from capture-recapture data

metadata.name: Mth_model
metadata.title: Capture-recapture model where detection probability varies by occasion and heterogeneity
metadata.description:
A capture-recapture sampling model where that assumes 
          detection probability p varies by an additive effect of the occasion
          and heterogeneity of individuals in a capture-history matrix with
          columns representing time, and rows representing individuals.
